rules.title: Commit the config
rules.text: Configure Oxlint in a committed .oxlintrc.json and keep the config in sync with the CI scripts.

rules.title: Explicit categories
rules.text: Enable the correctness category as error and add stricter categories deliberately.

rules.title: Oxfmt owns formatting
rules.text: Let Oxfmt own formatting and import order. Do not sort imports by hand.

rules.title: Type-aware linting
rules.text: Turn on type-aware linting with options.typeAware or --type-aware when you need rules that use TypeScript types.

rules.title: Review autofixes
rules.text: Apply safe fixes with oxlint --fix and review the diff before committing.

rules.title: Ignore generated output
rules.text: Exclude build output, coverage and snapshots with ignorePatterns in the config.

rules.title: No inline disables
rules.text: Do not add inline disables to silence a rule. Fix the code or change the shared config.

rules.title: Same scripts everywhere
rules.text: Run the same lint and format scripts locally, in hooks and in CI.
